notes:
Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Goal: add semantic search over product event docs + fast embeddings for feature tagging. Strong preference to start on Hosted API for speed of POC, then move to Dedicated if we hit throughput and cost thresholds.

Key ask from PM: generate embeddings for nightly batch job (~200k docs/day, avg doc size 600 tokens) and support 500 qps query load for internal product search (95th pct req latency <150ms). Cost-sensitive — wants clear per-embedding, per-query unit economics and a path to reserved pricing.

Security: SOC2 in vendor, customer data residency for EU-based subset of users, SSO/SAML for console access, KMS for key management. Must pass security questionnaire before infra access.

Model preferences: open/Redwood-verified medium models for embeddings (7B/13B variants), ability to fallback to quantized variants for Dedicated. Wants routing policy: queries routed to lower-cost model during non-peak windows.

Vector DB: currently evaluating Pinecone vs Milvus; integration requirement: bulk upsert API, shard-aware reindexing, soft-deletes, ability to store per-embed metadata. POC will include prototype using Pinecone + hosted embeddings.

Stakeholder quotes: "We need predictable cost if we roll this into product — can't have surprise token bills." — Head of Product. "Latency at scale is non-negotiable for search UX." — Eng manager.
